transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I'm... well, I'm here because of the voices. I keep hearing them. It's like someone is just standing right there in my studio. They say my name, and... they tell me my work is being judged. Even when it's completely quiet and no one else is around.
Have you been feeling unusually high, energized, or full of ideas lately?

I suppose. I just... I get so much energy sometimes. I can't really sit down. Like, I'll end up cleaning my whole kitchen, starting three different paintings... crocheting half a blanket. I even rewrite my care schedules for work. Just... all in the same night. I just keep going.
When you have that energy, do you need much less sleep than usual?

I guess so... yeah. I've gone a lot of nights sleeping... maybe two or three hours. But I wake up feeling charged. Like I had a full rest. So I just get up and... go straight back to painting, or making calls.
During those high-energy times, do you feel unusually important or specially gifted?

I... I don't know about "important." I just... well, I really believed my artwork was going to get discovered. Like, any day. And... I had this idea that I was supposed to build a whole new... care-and-art program. I just thought doctors and the agencies would come learn from me. That's all.
Have you heard the voices during times when your mood felt normal, not especially high or energized?

Yes... I suppose so. Even after the energy went away and I started sleeping regular hours again... they didn't stop. The voices, I mean. And... I still felt like people were watching me, or tracking what I was doing. It just kept going like that for... a few weeks, I think.
Did the voices start soon after you used any drugs or alcohol?
No... I don't really drink. And I don't use drugs. So... no, it wasn't that.
Have you had a period recently when you felt deeply depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really felt... down like that. Not recently, anyway. Just... no.
Altogether, have the voices and the feeling that people were watching or tracking you lasted for more than a month?
Yes... longer than a month. I guess... it's been about nine months now. The voices, and... feeling like they're watching what I do at work. It's been going on for that long.
Have the voices continued for at least two weeks when your mood was not high or unusually energized?

Yes... there was a time like that. After my energy dropped back down and I was... sleeping more normally again. The voices were still there. And I still felt like... people were watching my work, tracking me. That kept going for... a few weeks, I think. Even when I wasn't feeling so high.
Over these nine months, have those high-energy periods made up a large part of the time you’ve been unwell?

I suppose so, yes. Most of this time... I've been pretty wound up. Making big plans, not sleeping much, just... going all the time. And even when that stopped, I still wasn't... I wasn't really back to normal. But yeah, the high energy part was a lot of it.
